_comment: Bedrock settings for the whole-corpus LLM retrieval baseline. GPT-5.6 Luna is INFERENCE_PROFILE-only, and prompt caching for it is Responses-API-only (Converse supports the model but not its cache), so the runner posts to the OpenAI-compatible /openai/v1/responses path on bedrock-runtime with an explicit cache breakpoint.
_pricing_comment: USD per million tokens, from the GPT-5.6 Luna model card (Geo CRIS / us. profile). Bedrock charges a LONG-CONTEXT tier above 272K input tokens, and this corpus is ~445K, so the long rates apply to every call. The global. profile is about 9 percent cheaper if cross-region routing is acceptable.
_auth_comment: A Bedrock API key goes in the environment as AWS_BEARER_TOKEN_BEDROCK; boto3 picks it up. Standard AWS credentials or a profile also work. No key is ever written into this file or into any prompt.

bedrock._note: Bedrock adds a 10 percent fee over OpenAI list. Blocked on this account: entitlement reports AUTHORIZED but every inference API returns 403.

openai._note: The same model at list price. 1,050,000-token context. Long-context tier above 272K input: 2x input, 1.5x output.

_rate_limit_note: OpenAI Tier limit measured on this account: 500,000 tokens per minute for gpt-5.6-luna, and CACHED tokens count toward it. At ~444,850 tokens per call that allows roughly one call per 54s, so calls are paced at 57s. Raising the account's usage tier is what shortens the run.
